categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Faith Long Crystal Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of piezoelectric quartz crystal components, including SMD resonators, TSX thermosensitive crystals, TCXO oscillators, and OSC oscillators. The company also provides software and information technology services related to these products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced semiconductor-based photolithography technology for producing high-frequency, small-size quartz crystal wafers. It also employs multilayer and multi-metal sputtering coating, high-precision glue dispensing, ion etching frequency tuning, and high-frequency continuous pulse welding technologies. The production process emphasizes automation, digitalization, and intelligent manufacturing to ensure high precision and volume production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include well-known domestic and international smartphone manufacturers, smart home appliance companies, IoT module manufacturers, and IC design firms specializing in Beidou navigation. The products are widely used in communications electronics, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, industrial control, aerospace, and security products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with domestic sales accounting for approximately 79% of revenue and overseas sales about 21%. It has subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Chongqing, and a newly established subsidiary in South Korea, indicating a focus on both domestic and international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Faith Long Crystal operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying quartz crystal components to downstream electronics manufacturers and system integrators. It also engages in some upstream activities like raw material procurement and collaborates closely with suppliers for key materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-frequency, miniaturized, and high-precision quartz crystal components, including development of high-frequency thermosensitive crystals and temperature-compensated oscillators. It actively participates in industry standard setting, invests in intelligent manufacturing upgrades, and focuses on expanding into emerging sectors such as automotive electronics, IoT, Beidou navigation, and 5G applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of quartz crystal components and related electronic devices. The company also earns income from software and information technology services. Sales are conducted via direct sales to core customers and through distributors targeting component assemblers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Faith Long Crystal is one of the leading domestic manufacturers of MHz piezoelectric quartz crystal components in China, recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' and Guangdong provincial manufacturing champion. It competes with international firms mainly from Japan, the US, and Taiwan, with China gaining increasing global production share. The company holds certifications from major IC design platforms like Qualcomm and MediaTek, enhancing its competitive positioning.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 396 million, a slight increase of 0.34% year-over-year, but experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 162 million, a 20.37% decline from the previous year. The company has a total asset base of around RMB 1.78 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of about RMB 889 million. Sales volume grew significantly by over 40%, but average product prices declined, impacting profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Faith Long Crystal emphasizes its advanced technology in producing small-size, high-frequency, and high-precision quartz crystal components with strong reliability and performance. Its proprietary photolithography process and ability to mass-produce high-value-added products like TCXO oscillators and TSX thermosensitive crystals differentiate it from competitors. The company’s certifications from leading IC platform providers and deep integration with key customers in emerging sectors underpin its value proposition as a trusted, innovative supplier.
